findings.description: F-001: 'Enum здесь оправдан ... (глава 12 показывала эту идею на других примерах)' was a false cross-reference AND masked a missing prerequisite. Chapter 12 is 'Множество увлекательных мини-проектов!' and contains no Enum; grep across site/chapters/glava-01..17, notebooks/chapter-01..17 and scripts/build_chapter_01..17.py found zero occurrences. Yet Tool.PENCIL/Tool.RECTANGLE are used from here through 18.23, 18.32, the 18-13 notebook, the 18-13 grader and all of paint_app.py.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_13): removed the false 'глава 12' clause and replaced it with real guidance on when a plain string suffices; added a new h2 'Новое: Enum — заранее известный список вариантов' before the DrawingState code, motivating the problem (a mistyped string is silently valid) before the syntax, with a runnable enum_vpervye.py whose printed outputs were verified on Python 3.14.6, plus three bullet rules (member vs string, .value for JSON in 18.30, comparison with `is`). Chapter 19's copy was deliberately left untouched (sibling agent's scope). Verified: grep 'глава 12' -> 0 hits; grep 'Новое: Enum' -> PRESENT.

findings.description: F-009: the class_diagram caption said 'Один объект вместо семи отдельных переменных' but the diagram lists eight attributes, and the real DrawingState in paint_app.py had nine (pending_shapes). The code block shows only five with no elision marker.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_13): caption now reads 'Один объект вместо восьми отдельных переменных', matching the eight attributes the diagram lists. Verified PRESENT in regenerated HTML; 'вместо семи' -> 0 hits.
